description: One QR offer worked through by sealed_box.py and wa_pair_requests.py. The QR code's t is the 32 token bytes as base64url with no padding; offer_id is sha256(token bytes) as lower-case hex. The phone makes secret_b64, derives key = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = the raw token bytes, salt = 'wrist-assistant-offer-v1', info = device_id as UTF-8, 32 bytes) and seals the 32 raw secret bytes with AES-256-GCM, associated data 'pair_redeem', into envelope (the sealed_box.py envelope: box is the ciphertext followed by the 16 byte tag, standard base64 with padding), sent as sealed to /v2/pair/redeem. The server's reply body is signed with the new secret like a signed op's reply: HMAC-SHA256 hex over canonical_utf8, which is 'v2|pair_redeem|<device_id>|<X-WA-Ts>|response', a newline, then the body bytes exactly as received; X-WA-Ts and X-WA-Sig are headers. The phone checks the signature and that instance_id equals the QR code's i.
